items.q: Why does Dr. K say willpower is the wrong target?
items.a: Psychotherapy should change **personality-level tendencies** so behavior shifts without perpetual force. When you're no longer narcissistic (for example), **willpower isn't necessary** — identity change remits refractory depression and PTSD patterns.

items.q: Which two capacities are collapsing across diagnoses?
items.a: **Distress tolerance** (sitting with discomfort) and **intolerance of uncertainty** (needing defined answers) are worsening transdiagnostically — and both predict resilience when intact.

items.q: How do you tell ego desire from real drive?
items.a: Anything you want as a **comparison** (silver vs gold, tenure vs adjunct, looks ranking) is **born of the ego**. Separate those from an **internal desire roadmap**.

items.q: What's the hardest psychiatry problem Dr. K names?
items.a: Convincing people they **don't really want** what they claim — **sense organs** and social media feed manufactured wants that aren't true desires.

items.q: What are the three steps to feel your feelings?
items.a: **Recognize, allow, investigate** — without acting from raw emotion. Aim for tranquility in the face of emotion, neither suppression nor explosion.

items.q: How does criticism actually land, and what's the defense?
items.a: Criticism is a **poison dart**: precision at linguistic weak points, not volume. Build **Teflon Buddha** imperviousness. For narcissism patterns, **shunya void** meditation strips attributes until you contact self beyond labels.

items.q: What sankalpa does Dr. K prefer for trauma patients?
items.a: **"I deserve to be whole"** — not "I am whole." Pair with **Yoga Nidra** to burn **samskara** roots; liminal hypnagogic windows also favor belief rewiring.

items.q: Why does needing certainty kill flirting and social skill?
items.a: Flirting preserves **plausible deniability**; neutral observers detect it only about **24–42%** of the time. Training for certainty breaks the social dance.

items.q: How do gifted kids and porn show up clinically?
items.a: Gifted + internet → school pace mismatch, games with level pacing, then **failure to launch**. Young-men ED under 30 rose roughly **~5% → ~20%**, often **completion** not initiation failure — emotional more than purely vascular.

items.q: What AI mental-health warning does he raise?
items.a: A first case report of **AI-chat psychosis** with hospitalization and antipsychotics in someone **without prior history** — a scary mechanism worth treating as real risk, not sci-fi.
